author: steven5703
body:
There should be an option to have your map have a custom resource pack. Like, if it was a star wars, you could set villagers skin to be darth vader or something. 

There would be a YAML option:
resource-pack:
 link: http://www.fileuploadingwebsite.com/file
OR: You could tell the map devs to add it to the map folder.
resource-pack:
 location: avicus/maps/nebula/swag/swag.zip


EDIT:
Should be a item and when you right click it, it prompts you to download the texture pack instead of it always asking to download the texture pack. -cupcake

replies.author: Netuxx
replies.body:
I got this idea before but i see some problems like if you are using the Bukkit API you can't code the "The server wants you to use this resourcepack" menu. I think any APIs like ProtocolLib got a metod for it neither... There is a way i didn't tested:
A plugin can change the "server.propieties" file. But it needs to reload the server and relog players. That last thing may cause crashes on Minecraft Clients

#JustToYouGuysKnow:
Resource packs downloaded from a server are archived at "server-resource-packs" on ".minecraft". They dont have an extension.
